newsitem.title: USA: James River sees recovery in two areas.
newsitem.headline: James River sees recovery in two areas.

text.p: James River Corp said Thursday it sees signs of recovery in the pulp market and among pricing in its communications paper segment.

In the first quarter, the company's communications papers business, which is principally involved in photocopying paper, reported an operating loss of $3.6 million compared with operating income of $4.2 million for the same quarter a year ago.

The company said that although stronger volumes increased sales in that segment to $119 million in the first quarter compared to $112 million in the same period in the prior year, weaker prices affected the bottom line.
However, James River said in a statement that it is seeing signs of pricing recovery "on the horizon" as it begins its second quarter.
Chairman and Chief Executive Miles Marsh also said in a statement that an expected recovery in the underlying pulp market will soon lead to improved pricing in many of its end markets.
